title: 第15章 裂隙第16章 圣光与铁锈
slug: 黯潮纪元异世界的崛起
lines: 晨会室的窗户开着，空气还是闷得像压了块湿布。
加雷斯站在地图前，手指在边境线上划了一道。他的指节粗大，指甲缝里嵌着洗不掉的灰——那是长期握剑留下的印记。
“铁王国第三军昨晚在灰烬隘口外扎营。”他顿了顿，“离我们的哨塔不到三公里。”
驼子靠在墙边，手里的烟卷烧到了滤嘴都没察觉。
维克托皱眉：“他们越界了。”
“没越。”加雷斯的手指敲了敲地图，“恰好踩在边界线上。但他们的斥候昨晚摸进了我们的巡逻路线。”
陈默坐在后排，注意到加雷斯的拇指在桌沿反复摩擦——那是紧张时的习惯动作。
“教廷怎么说？”维克托问。
加雷斯沉默了两秒。
“教廷派人来了。”他的语气平淡得反常，“今天下午到。”
驼子把烟头摁灭在墙上：“操。”
晨会散了。
陈默收拾笔记时，加雷斯走到他身边。声音压得很低：“你昨天在训练场上的表现，有人报上去了。”
陈默抬头，心跳漏了一拍。
“我没法压住所有的东西。”加雷斯拍了拍他的肩膀，力道比平时重，“自己小心。”
门关上时，木框震了一下。
实战训练在操场东侧。
地面踩实了，露出干裂的黄土。边缘插着几根木桩，上面刀痕叠刀痕，最深的地方裂开了手指宽的缝。
陈默站在队列里，阳光晒在后颈上，皮肤开始发烫。
对面的对手是第三小队的副队长——一个叫罗恩的中年骑士。他的圣光凝在剑刃上，泛着淡金色的光晕。
“开始！”
罗恩冲过来，圣光在剑尖炸开。
陈默侧身闪避，剑刃擦过他的肩膀，带起一阵灼热。他反手劈向罗恩的腰侧，剑被对方格挡，金属碰撞的声音震得耳膜发嗡。
罗恩后退半步，剑尖重新凝聚圣光。
“你的圣光呢？”他问。
陈默没回答。
他不想用。上次在训练场，他只是尝试引导，圣光就失控了——那种力量像活物，会主动寻找出口。
罗恩皱眉，再次进攻。
这次更快。剑光从左侧劈下，陈默格挡，巨大的力量震得他手臂发麻。罗恩的圣光顺着剑刃蔓延过来，像藤蔓一样缠绕上陈默的手腕。
刺痛。
陈默本能地调动体内的力量——不是圣光，是另一股更深、更暗的东西。
门。
空间在他眼前扭曲了一下。
罗恩的圣光像被吸进了漩涡，瞬间消散。剑刃上淡金色的光芒熄灭，变成普通的铁灰色。
罗恩愣住了。
“你做了什么？”他的声音变了调。
陈默低头看自己的手——没有圣光，没有痕迹。但手腕上残留着一种冰冷的触感，像被什么东西从内部抚摸过。
“我什么都没做。”
罗恩后退一步，剑尖指向他：“你的圣光有问题。”
周围的人围了过来。有人低声议论，有人盯着陈默的手，眼神里带着恐惧。
维克托拨开人群走进来，看了一眼罗恩，又看了一眼陈默。
“散了。”他说，“训练结束。”
人群慢慢散开，但那些目光还贴在陈默背上，像钉进去的钉子。
content_en:
The windows of the morning meeting room were open, but the air was still as stuffy as a damp cloth.
Gareth stood in front of the map and drew a line along the border with his finger. His knuckles were thick, and there was indelible dust embedded in the gaps between his nails - the marks left by holding the sword for a long time.
"The Third Army of the Iron Kingdom camped outside the Ash Pass last night." He paused, "less than three kilometers away from our guard tower."
The hunchback leaned against the wall, the cigarette in his hand burning to the filter without even noticing.
Victor frowned: "They crossed the line."
"No crossing." Gareth tapped his finger on the map, "It happened to be on the border. But their scouts got into our patrol route last night."
Chen Mo was sitting in the back row and noticed Gareth's thumb rubbing repeatedly on the edge of the table - it was a habitual action when he was nervous.
"What did the Holy See say?" Victor asked.
Gareth was silent for two seconds.
"The Holy See has sent someone." His tone was unusually calm, "They will arrive this afternoon."
The hunchback put out the cigarette butt against the wall: "Fuck."
The morning meeting is over.
When Chen Mo was packing up his notes, Gareth walked up to him. His voice was very low: "Your performance on the training ground yesterday was reported to you."
Chen Mo looked up and his heart skipped a beat.
"I can't hold everything down." Gareth patted his shoulder harder than usual, "Be careful."
The wooden frame shook as the door closed.
***
Practical training is on the east side of the playground.
The ground was stepped hard, revealing dry and cracked loess. There were several wooden stakes stuck on the edge, with knife marks stacked on top of each other, and the deepest part had a crack as wide as a finger.
Chen Mo stood in the queue, the sun shining on the back of his neck, and his skin began to feel hot.
The opponent on the opposite side is the vice-captain of the third team - a middle-aged knight named Ron. His holy light condensed on the blade, glowing with a light golden halo.
"Start!"
Ron rushed over, and the holy light exploded at the tip of the sword.
Chen Mo dodged sideways, and the sword blade grazed his shoulder, causing a burst of heat. He slashed at Ron's waist with his backhand, and the sword was blocked by the opponent. The sound of metal collision made his eardrums buzz.
Ron took half a step back, and the holy light regrouped at the tip of his sword.
"Where is your Holy Light?" he asked.
Chen Mo didn't answer.
He doesn't want to use it. Last time at the training ground, he just tried to guide, and the Holy Light went out of control - that kind of power was like a living creature, actively looking for an exit.
Ron frowned and attacked again.
This time it was faster. The sword light struck from the left, and Chen Mo blocked it. The huge force made his arm numb. Ron's holy light spread along the blade and wrapped around Chen Mo's wrist like a vine.
Tingling.
Chen Mo instinctively mobilized the power in his body - not the holy light, but something deeper and darker.
Door.
Space distorted before his eyes.
Ron's holy light image was sucked into the vortex and dissipated instantly. The pale golden light on the sword blade extinguished and turned into an ordinary iron gray.
Ron was stunned.
"What did you do?" His voice changed.
Chen Mo looked down at his hands - there was no holy light, no trace. But there was a cold feeling on my wrist, as if something had touched it from the inside.
"I didn't do anything."
Ron took a step back, pointing the tip of his sword at him: "There is something wrong with your Holy Light."
People gathered around. Some people were talking in low voices, and some were staring at Chen Mo's hands with fear in their eyes.
Victor walked through the crowd, glanced at Ron, and then at Chen Mo.
"It's over," he said. "Training is over."
The crowd slowly dispersed, but those eyes were still stuck on Chen Mo's back, like nails driven into it.
title_en: Chapter 15 Crack Chapter 16 Holy Light and Rust
